name: Bishoujo Ren'ai Mahjong Series: Karan Koron Gakuen: Mune Kyun Hen
original_name: 美少女恋愛麻雀シリーズ 華蘭虎龍学園 むねきゅん編
source:
Second series of mahjong simulation game presents a new set of three heroines to defeat and fall in love with. One story takes at an airport, another one is devoted to cooking, and the last one reminisces about the past days.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
麻将模拟游戏第二系列呈现了一组新的三位女主角，可供击败和爱上。一个故事发生在机场，另一个故事是关于烹饪，最后一个故事是回忆过去的日子。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
